fastanim:
How does this benefit performance?

Each time Minecraft wants to draw a frame, ALL entities recalculate the angles of each of their limbs. However, due to a huge oversight by Mojang, MANY of these calculations can easily be sped up, and are sometimes flat-out unnecessary. This mod fixes that by making PI/180 a stored value that isn't calculated multiple times for each entity, using variables instead of repeated calculations, and more. This, when applied to all entities, does indeed speed up performance, whether it be a small bit or a noticeable bit, depending on the surrounding entities and your PC.

This mod is archived.

这对性能有何好处？ 每次《我的世界》想要画一个框架的时候，所有的实体都会重新计算它们的每一个肢体的角度。然而，由于Mojang的疏忽，这些计算中的很多都可以很容易地被加速，有时候甚至是完全没有必要的。这个模组通过将PI/180设置为一个存储值来修复这个问题，这个值不会为每个实体计算多次，使用变量来代替重复计算等等。这，当应用于所有实体时，确实会提高性能，无论是一点点还是明显的一点，这取决于周围的实体和您的PC。 此模式已存档。

Differences with original mod:

- Added compatibility with many mods.
- Fixed many issues, like snow was generating on manually grown trees from saplings.
- Just fixes bug by default. Original mod was generating snow on leaves under leaves. We have config option for this,
 not enabled by default.
- Doesn't include the snow under trees feature, since it is implemented well
 in Snow Under Trees mod,
 which has fixed many problems and compatibility issues. There is no reason to duplicate its function.

 Features

In Minecraft 1.12 and later, snow often doesn’t fully cover tree leaves in snowy biomes,
including modded ones, making trees look bad—especially large modded ones.

It's because of a Vanilla bug, MC-119599.
When terrain is generated chunk by chunk, snow is placed in a chunk before trees are added in neighboring

earlygame:
A Fabric mod focusing on changing early game aspects to make the game feel more "realistic". 

 Background
This idea revolves around the fact that as of this writing, no such mods for early game realism are present in the Fabric mod database. Then I thought, "Fine, I'll do it myself." Moreover, it was inspired by two particular Forge mods that have the same premise, namely No Tree Punching and Natural Progression.

 Features

- Disabled the ability to get wood from punching trees
- Proper tools are required to collect stone and wood
- Chopping logs to make planks, and planks to sticks
- Rocks and sticks are naturally generated around the world
- Cobblestone variants
- Makeshift flint tools
- Copper items, tools and armor
- Knives and saws serving as alternatives

More details are in the wiki.

 Screenshots
 Show 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Dependencies

 Required

- Fabric API 
 - 1.16: 0.30.0+1.16

ChatTweaks

 
 

ChatTweaks is a bundle of small improvements for the Minecraft chat.

 Compact chat

Repeated messages stack into one line with a counter like (2) instead of filling up your chat.

- Choose how recent a message has to be to stack (up to 2 minutes)
- 10 counter formats and a custom counter color
- Only stack a message when it repeats the one right above it

 

 Chat history

- Keep up to 16384 messages instead of the vanilla 100
- Chat no longer clears when you leave a world or server
- History is saved per account and per server, and comes back when you rejoin
- A divider with the date and time marks each new session

 Image preview

Hover over a link in chat to see the image next to your cursor. This works for web pages that have a preview image and for your own screenshots too. Hold Shift to see it at full size.

 

 Timestamps

- Show the time in front of each message

longview:
Longview is a mod for Minecraft 26.1 that fixes glitches such as Z-fighting and jaggies on far distances.

This is accomplished through two techniques:
1) By changing the Z coordinate limits from [-1,1] to [0,1] using the GL ARB CLIP CONTROL extension (officially part of OpenGL 4.5)
2) By applying the reversed Z technique, where the far plane and the near plane are swapped in the renderer.

This ensures that the depth buffer will be evenly distributed no matter the distance, fixing all sorts of glitches that happens from a distance!

 Compatibility

This mod is no longer needed in Minecraft 26.2+ since the game has implemented the same fixes that Longview implements! This mod will continue to work in Minecraft 26.1.

This mod requires a device supporting either the GL ARB CLIP CONTROL extension or OpenGL 4.5 in order to apply Technique 1.

hyperbox:
The Hyperbox block acts as a portal to another dimension. Each hyperbox has its own dimension stored within; should the block be mined and placed somewhere else, the dimension will remain linked to that block.

 

Activating the block sends the player inside this dimension; within the block's dimension are apertures on the walls, which can be activated to return to the overworld.

 

The apertures transmit redstone power and forge capabilities (such as items being inserted or extracted from hoppers) between the inside and the outside faces of the box, allowing large machines to be constructed in tiny spaces.

 

The hyperbox is intended to be compatible with anything from other mods that uses standard redstone power or forge's capability system.

 

Technical details:

 The hyperbox world's chunk is a single chunk at chunk position 0,0. The size of the space useable by the player is 13x1

kac:
How does it work? 

Kinetic Anti-Cheat scans a player's mods folder and checks it against a whitelist that can be modified by you. If it finds a mod that is not on the whitelist, it will kick them from the server. After kicking the player, the anti-cheat will then print a log with the mods the player tried to join with and their name. 

All logs will be saved in the illegal client folder. You can then chose to add the mod to your whitelist to allow the player to join with that mod.

It will also block liteloader mods and pixel/poke radar.
 
 
 Is it foolproof? 

Not by any means, but it will be a huge help in stopping people from joining your server with a mod such as X-Ray. It will block any unknown Forge mod and the 1.12 version will also block lite loader mods. 

It has no way of knowing if someone is using an X-Ray Texture Pack. These should be able to be blocked by a simple plugin.

REI Enchantment Info
 Summary

This is mod is an addon for REI (Roughly Enough Items) that allows users to view details of an enchantment. No more, no less.

 For modders

In your lang file, add:
 
"enchantment.modid.ench name.rei.func": "value"
"enchantment.modid.ench name.rei.applicability": "value"
 
where value is the string you want to display.

 .func and .applicability?

.func purpose is to display the use of an enchantment.

.applicability is to display what items can be enchanted with the enchantment.

 Why .applicability when minecraft has built-in EnchantmentTarget class?

Because some mods may override enchantment's application.

 Screenshots

tick-tweaks:
Knowledge before installing

 
 Spoiler 

 Game Tick
A game tick is a single cycle of Minecraft’s game loop, where the game updates actions, events, and mechanics like movement, block changes, and redstone.

 Tick Rate
Controls how often entities (like mobs, items, and projectiles) update.

 TPS
This measures the game's overall tick speed, ideally 20 ticks per second. When the TPS drops below 20, the game may lag, affecting all processes.

 

 Description
This mod enhances server performance by adjusting Tick Rates for Item Entities, Block Entities and Living Entities. Adjusts the Tick Rate based on Server TPS; lower TPS results in a lower Tick Rate.

It also implements some features for improving the game performance, you can have a look in "Configs" section.

It is very recommended to change the configs to your server's preferences. Don't put all at once without knowing what are you do

VoxLink

Play with your friends, or find new ones in the lobby :D

---

 How to play

Open your world, create a room, get a 6-digit code , send it to your friend, they type it in, done. No port forwarding, no router stuff, no server, you don't even need to know what a public IP is. Install mod, make room, send code, that's it.

Usually connects within seconds -- connection time and success rate depend on both sides' network: same ISP home broadband almost always works, campus WiFi, office network, phone hotspot may fluctuate. qcraft:
About

qCraft is a mod that introduced many concepts of Quantum Physics into Minecraft. It was beloved by the community for its novel ideas and interesting capabilities; unfortunately, its development lay dormant for many years. qCraft Reimagined aims to bring the mod back into the spotlight.

 Features

- Blocks that change state depending on the face observed
- Practical redstone randomness
- Machines that will perform quantum observations automatically
- Computers that can swap entire regions of the world

...and much more! See the wiki for in-depth feature explanations and tutorials.

 Credits

- This mod wouldn't have been possible without fantastic art by VirtuaLilith. I may have programmed the internal logic, but she really brought the mod to life!
- Trudle helped me with Portuguese localization; I'm not exactly fluent yet.
- Mind-boggling math problems were solved by the Quilt co

Superb Extras

 [EN]

 Superb Extras is an addon for Superb Warfare that improves combat, vehicles, explosives, weapon handling, and interface behavior while also adding a small amount of new content.

It focuses on practical quality-of-life changes and fixes that make Superb Warfare more convenient and consistent during regular gameplay.

 Key Features

- More dynamic explosions: Rockets and shells can ignite nearby blocks after detonation.
- Better item survival: Dropped items have a chance to survive explosions instead of always being destroyed.
- Persistent Claymores: Claymore mines can remain in the world until triggered or removed.
- Improved mortars: Adjustable mortar accuracy and optional automatic loading through powered hoppers.
- Vehicle fixes: Better tracking of the latest vehicle driver and more consistent ownership behavior.
- Retrievable TOW launcher: Pick up a deployed TO

Client side painting variants

Use resource packs to add new types of painting without removing any existing paintings, entirely on the client side!

 

This mod requires Fabric API, so make sure it's installed with this mod.

 Wait, how is this different from 1.21's painting variants?

Minecraft 1.21 adds painting variants that rely on data packs to specify new variants. Unfortunately this means that these paintings must be defined per world, or set up by the server's admin. What this mod does is extend that idea further, allowing resource packs to define more painting variants for any players using the mod on their clients. Clients without the mod just see the regular paintings.

This does lead to the one limitation of this mod: it can't add new sizes of paintings, just add more variants to existing sizes (whether they're defined by Minecraft or a data pack).

NoPlaceDelay

Tired of that annoying pause between block placements? NoPlaceDelay eliminates the built-in 4-tick delay so you can place blocks as fast as you click.

---

🔧 What does it do?

In vanilla Minecraft, every time you place a block there is a forced 4-tick (~200ms) cooldown before you can place another one. This makes rapid building feel sluggish and unresponsive.

NoPlaceDelay removes this restriction entirely — the moment you right-click, the next block is ready to go. Whether you're speed-bridging, building massive structures, or just placing a few blocks, everything feels instant and smooth.

---

✨ Features

• ⚡ Zero placement delay — place blocks back-to-back with no cooldown

• 🖱️ Works with hold & click — both clicking rapidly and holding right-click benefit

• 🪶 Lightweight — a tiny client-side mixin, no performance impact

• 🔌 Plug and play — drop it in your mods

Gearwork is a Sable-based mobility mod for Create-style contraptions, focused on wheels, tracks, landing gear, and other practical ground-contact mechanisms.

The goal of Gearwork is to make moving contraptions feel more physical, stable, and useful. Gearwork aims to provide configurable components that interact with mass, suspension, steering, traction, braking, and terrain contact in a more believable way.

The mod is built around the Sable physics engine and uses Synaxis as its compatibility and infrastructure layer, keeping low-level physics integration separated from gameplay-facing systems. This allows Gearwork to focus on clean vehicle components, good controls, and extensible mechanics for future ground vehicles, aircraft landing systems, and heavy machinery.

Gearwork is still in active development, so features, balance, and APIs may change over time.

This mod simply adds a new item called the Time Watch which allows you to stop/resume time, thanks to minecraft's new tickrate api.

 Time Watch Recipe
 

 Questions
Q: Do I need access to cheats to use the watch?\
A: The watch will work perfectly fine without cheats.

Q: Will stopping/resuming time using cheats break the Time Watch?\
A: The watch toggles based on whether time is stopped or not, so using cheats will not break the watch.

Q: Does this mod work in multiplayer?\
A: I haven't tested, but I'd assume so, with the exception of freezing other players.

Q: Can I use your mod in my modpack?\
A: Absolutely, as long as you give credit!

Q: Why did you make this mod?\
A: I ended up making this mod as a proof of concept, that you could use the tickrate api in more than just commands. I just decided to publish it so others could see how to use the tickrate api as well

Codec2Schema

Through the power of mixins, sheer will, and unchecked type casts, this mod transforms codecs into (mostly) usable JSON schemas.

You can find the generated schemas for vanilla Minecraft here.

 What is a Codec?

Codecs are Mojang's way of easily serializing data to and from JSON. They define the structure of an object, meaning JSON schemas can be generated from them.

 What is a JSON Schema?

A JSON schema is a file that describes how JSON files should be structured, and can be used by IDEs to provide autocomplete when creating or editing JSON files.

 About This Mod

When installed, this mod exports JSON schemas for data and resource pack files to /codec2schema . You can use the API to export your own codecs as well!

The generated JSON schemas will have autocomplete for registries (items, blocks, etc), including modded content.

The Peeker
This mod adds a strange creature that doesn’t attack, doesn’t speak, and doesn’t drop loot. It’s called The Peeker, and its only purpose is to watch.

It spawns randomly and very rarely—usually on ledges, behind walls, or in places where you wouldn’t expect anything to be. It has no legs, long skinny arms, and glowing eyes that stand out in the dark. You’ll spot it for a moment, and then it’s gone.

There’s no fight. No reward. Just a quiet, creepy presence that makes you wonder how long it’s been there.

The Peeker is perfect for players who enjoy subtle horror and atmospheric tension. It’s not about survival—it’s about the feeling that you’re never truly alone.

This mod will show you all explored areas of your world, by rendering them when you go near them, and saving the pictures. It's not perfect quality, or even good, but it works surprisingly well.

Note that it can use quite a lot of disk space - hundreds of megabytes in my testing, probably gigabytes for larger worlds.

Consider this an alpha release. Current limitations and issues:

 It doesn't distinguish between different servers - data from one server will overwrite data from another server. (It does distinguish between different singleplayer worlds, and between singleplayer worlds and servers)
 It breaks fog in the nether - the background will be black.
 It doesn't handle night - all chunks rendered by InfiView will be fullbright.
 It can cause significant FPS drops intermittently.

Fullbright

Ever joined a survival server, wandered into a cave or a dark forest at night, and just... couldn't see anything? No OP, no way to get a Night Vision potion, and turning your monitor brightness all the way up still doesn't cut it? That's exactly why Fullbright exists.

Press G and the dark instantly becomes readable. Press it again and everything goes back to normal. That's the whole idea.

 This is not the vanilla Night Vision effect

That's the important part. Fulbright doesn't give you the Night Vision status effect. It never touches potions, it never asks the server for anything, and it doesn't show up as an effect icon in your inventory. A server admin can't see it, can't remove it, and can't block it with a plugin that strips effects.

Instead, Fulbright works the same way old-school "fullbright" resource packs always have: it turns up your own brightness/gamma renderin

Still There? (AFK Screen) is a 100% Client-Side Quality of Life (QoL) mod designed to protect your computer's performance and temperature when you step away from the keyboard.

Main Features:

Smart Detection: Automatically monitors mouse and keyboard activity.

Extreme Resource Saving: After a configurable period of inactivity (5 minutes by default), the mod opens a blurred cinematic screen and throttles the game down to 10 FPS. This allows your CPU and GPU to rest, drastically reducing power consumption and heat.

Instant Restoration: click, or press any key. The mod will close instantly and restore your exact original framerate so you can continue playing smoothly.

Highly Configurable: Includes a config file (pausescreen-client.toml) that lets you decide exactly how many minutes must pass before the screen triggers.

Multilingual Support: Fully translated

 No Pot Effect removes the three most annoying visual effects in Minecraft that disrupt PvP encounters and cause eye strain:

1. FOV distortion — completely disables camera zooming animations when under speed or slowness potion effects, keeping your field of view perfectly locked.

{

disable-back-perspective:
Disable Back Perspective

A client-side Minecraft mod for Fabric that disables the back perspective (the camera facing the back of the player's head). This can be toggled with a keybind.

 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader . 
2. Place the mod .jar in your mods folder, alongside Fabric API . 
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric.

 Usage

- The mod is active by default , meaning you can only switch between first-person and third-person front (camera facing the player's face) perspectives using Vanilla's "Toggle Perspective" keybind. 
- You can toggle the mod on or off with a keybind (default: \ ). 
- The keybind can be changed in Minecraft's settings.

 Notes

- Client-side only — safe to join any server (vanilla, modded, Paper, etc.). 
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

deathcore:
DEATHCORE 1.3.0 
Fabric 1.21.11 纯服务端个人死亡排行榜

==================== 中文 ====================

简介

Deathcore 为 Fabric 1.21.11 服务器添加一个简洁的侧边栏死亡榜。榜单按死亡数从高到低排列，每位玩家可以独立设置自己想看到的人数，管理员可以设置服务器默认显示人数和更多展示选项。

这是纯服务端模组：Java 客户端无需安装。通过 Geyser 加入服务器的基岩版玩家同样可以看到榜单，无需安装客户端内容。Geyser 受到支持，但不是本模组的必需依赖。

运行要求

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.16.0 或更高版本
- 对应 1.21.11 的 Fabric API
- Java 21 或更高版本

功能

- 纯服务端，无需客户端模组
- 兼容 Java 客户端和通过 Geyser 加入的基岩版玩家
- 按死亡数从高到低排列，相同死亡数按玩家名排序
- 每位玩家可单独设置自己的榜单显示人数
- 可设置全局默认榜单人数
- 个人设置不需要 OP 权限
- 全局服务器设置需要 2 级权限
- 自定义榜单标题
- 可选显示排名序号
- 可选显示零死亡的在线玩家
- 支持启用、关闭、重载与强制刷新
- JSON 配置自动保存

玩家命令

/deathcore
查看 Deathcore 当前状态。

/deathcore help
查看常用命令。

/deathcore home set 
设置自己看到的死亡榜人数。设为 0 可只对自己隐藏死亡榜。

/deathcore home reset
删除个人设置，重新使用服务器全局默认人数。

/deathcore home status
查看当前使用的是个人设置还是全局设置。

管理员命令（需要 2 级权限）

/deathcore server set 
设置全局默认死亡榜人数。

/deathcore server on
为所有玩家启用死亡榜。

/deathcore

 Usage

- Released fish create particle burst to confirm karma gain
- Separate tracking for lifetime releases and current karma score
- Zero tick impact during normal gameplay - calculations only occur during fishing events
- Creates choice between immediate resource gain and long-term fishing investment

 What is Lockout?
Lockout is played on a random Minecraft world in survival mode. Two teams try to complete more than half the objectives on a board of typically 25 goals. The goals can be easy like 'Eat Apple' or as challenging as 'Enter End City'. Each goal is worth one point. Once one team completes a goal, the other team is "locked out" of that goal and can no longer earn a point for it. The first team to complete more than half the board wins.

BlockPixel: Founded in 2011 
The moment I first encountered Minecraft, my perspective on everything shifted. The vivid world of Minecraft, where everything is square and even the impossible feels real, became the most striking image in my imagination. These unforgettable experiences inspired me to create BlockPixel, a project dedicated to showcasing the charm of square textures and exploring the unique appeal of Minecraft.

 Additional Content

This is a Christmas add-on designed for survival adventures, adding more festive atmosphere without altering the recognizability of original blocks and items. The content is currently limited but will continue to grow, including additions like villagers and mobs. Please ensure it is loaded on top of the BlockPixel texture pack.

A Vanilla shader resource pack implementing anti-aliasing and sharpening using the end-of-frame post effect added in Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 3. The technique is a modified Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing 1x followed by a modified FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening 1.2.

 The shaders require graphics drivers with support for GLSL 4.40 . If you have a decently modern non-macOS device, it probably supports this, but you might have to update your graphics drivers. If support is missing, the pack will fail to load.

When Minecraft is using the Vulkan graphics API, the shaders may use lower precision math to improve performance. The behavior of this feature depends on your GPU and graphics drivers. Try switching graphics API if you're experiencing issues with the shaders, and please report them on the issue tracker.

noblockrotations:
NoBlockRotations
 A texture pack that removes block rotations in modern Minecraft versions. 

 My Discord
 Join my Discord for support!

 What does this do?
This pack allows you to safely play on servers like DonutSMP without worrying about your base coordinates being leaked.

 How does it work?
It replaces the block rotation textures with non-rotated versions, thus getting rid of viewable block rotations.

 Why do you need to remove block rotations?
Well, block rotations are not tied to the seed, but the actual coordinates of the blocks. This means that if someone can see a screenshot of your base or a stream or video of your base, they can figure out the coordinates of your base just by looking at specific blocks that have rotations.

 Which blocks have rotations?
- Bedrock
- Concrete Powder
- Dirt
- Dirt Path
- Grass Block
- Lily Pad
- Mycelium
- Podzol
- Sand (Including Red Sand)
- S

Overview
 
The British Rail Class 142 “Pacer” is a diesel multiple unit built between 1985 and 1987 by Leyland Bus and BREL in the United Kingdom.
Originally designed as a low-cost solution for lightly used regional and suburban routes, the Class 142 is based on bus technology and became well known for its distinctive ride characteristics.

The Class 142 was primarily used on regional and suburban services, especially in the north of England, where it later became strongly associated with Northern Rail operations.

This resource pack adds the British Rail Class 142 to Minecraft using Minecraft Transit Railway 4 (MTR4).

AntiLeak

 Hides the bedrock pattern and ore layout that let someone work out where your base is from a single screenshot. 

 How people actually get leaked

Bedrock generates in a pattern that is unique to each spot in the world, and so is the scatter of ores, gravel, clay and stone variants around it. Post one screenshot of your base, your storage room or your mining floor, and anyone holding the world seed can match that pattern against the world and read your coordinates straight off it.

No plugin on the server can stop that, because the leak is not happening on the server. It is happening in your own screenshot.

AntiLeak replaces every one of those textures with the same flat, noisy tile. Bedrock looks like stone. Deepslate looks like stone. Every ore looks like stone. There is no pattern left in the picture, so there is nothing to match.

 What it covers

62 textures.

 Overworld

 Default 
If you do nothing, all players on the server need to be sleeping in a bed to skip the night. This rarely ever happens on servers due to a lack of coordination.  /gamerule playersSleepingPercentage

skill:
SkillForge is a cinematic LitRPG plugin that transforms Minecraft into a skill-based adventure. Players level up by performing actions—mining, fighting, fishing, taming—and unlock powerful abilities as they grow. With party mechanics, leaderboards, and immersive feedback like titles and action bars, SkillForge brings RPG progression to life.
The plugin features modular managers, database persistence, and clean architecture for easy expansion. Abilities are defined in a separate config and triggered automatically when players reach key milestones. SQLite is supported out of the box, with optional MySQL integration.
Designed for servers that want mythic progression, community-driven play, and a touch of spectacle. Drop it in, configure your skills and abilities, and let players forge their legend.
